Note to the teacher
• With the help of the pictures, narrate the story in simple English
using voice modulation and actions.
• Draw the attention of the children to the details in the illustrations.
• Ask questions to elicit answers in English. Even if a child answers
in one word like ‘cap’ instead of “This is a cap.”, accept the answer.
• Ensure that the children have understood the story. After a few
days, repeat the story to reinforce the usage of English words.
